record.title: Myanmar–Laos Friendship Bridge COVID restriction with May 2022 cargo permission
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.direction: Bilateral bridge movement; cargo protocol described for both parties.
record.movement: Bridge movement; ordinary passenger prohibition remained after controlled cargo permission.
record.exceptions: Only driver and conductor at designated loading places under vaccination/test conditions; ordinary passengers still barred.
record.enforcement: Official ceremony and operating rules establish permission; first actual cargo journey not established.
record.relationship: Promotes initial restriction from R5-EA-L001 with qualified 2022 cargo endpoint; residual Jan 2024 phase remains a lead. Related national records EA016/R2-EA-005 are broader and different in scope.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; unknown endpoints are not extended to 21 October 2026.
record.official_rationale: COVID-19 outbreak, according to official retrospective report.
record.context: Initial pandemic restriction and limited May 2022 formal cargo restoration; later January 2024 ceremony is a separate unresolved phase.
record.uncertainty: 2020 onset is approximate retrospective chronology, not recovered order date. Four-year blanket closure in CNI2024 conflicts with May 2022 permission. No continuous duration or full passenger reopening claimed.

historical.duration_note: Formal permission or repeal; operational continuity and first physical reopening are not established.
